Name: Blood Dinosaurs
Author: Day3FierceDiety
Description:
This is a very simple mod. Dinosaurs are now White and Red.

﻿Installation Instructions:
-After downloading, extract file
-navigate to the StardewValley folder location
-if desired, make a backup of your Content folder (recommended)
-Drag and drop the the new Content folder into StardewValley and replace files in destination
